params.name: page
params.description:
The page number for [paginated results](/products/payments-odl/api-docs/ripplenet/best-practices/pagination/). The value is zero-based, where `0` represents the first page.
Set it to `0` to get the first page of results.

params.name: size
params.description: Number of objects to return per page.

params.name: with_labels
params.description:
Returns transfers that contain any of the specified labels.

Example - `?with_labels=LABEL1,LABEL2`

params.name: without_labels
params.description: Returns transfers that do not contain any of the specified labels.

params.name: include_labels
params.description:
Returns labels added to each Transfer object. By default labels are not returned.

Example - `?with_labels=LABEL1&include_labels=true`

params.name: state
params.description: Filter by transfer states.

params.name: internal_id
params.description: Optional parameter for filtering with internalId.

params.name: sender_end_to_end_id
params.description: Optional parameter for filtering with sender end to end id.

params.name: sort_field
params.description: Field used to sort the results.

params.name: sort_direction
params.description: Sort direction.

params.name: account
params.description: RippleNet account which is involved in transfer

params.name: transfer_account_role
params.description: by default account parameter would search both sender and receiver of transfer and bring the results. This is to restrict the account search to sender or receiver of a transfer

params.name: sender_address
params.description: RippleNet address of the xRapid account from which the transfer is funded

params.name: receiver_address
params.description: RippleNet address representing an account outside of RippleNet to which the transfer amount is sent.

params.name: amount
params.description: The amount to be transferred

items.docs: Get an estimate of the fee to make an "outbound" transfer from an exchange (connected to xRapid) to an another account outside of RippleNet (such as a bank account). This operation is only available to xCurrent instances enabled as receivers of xRapid payments.

params.name: transfer_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the transfer you want to retrieve.

params.name: include_labels
params.description: Returns labels added to each Transfer object. By default labels are not returned.

items.docs: Transfers funds between accounts. For example, use this request to fund a connector account by transferring funds from a transactional account to the connector account. You can also use this request to redeem funds to a transactional account by transferring funds from a connector account to the transactional account.

params.name: transfer_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the transfer you want to complete.

items.docs: Updates the state of a transfer to `COMPLETED`. Make this request once the transfer has been made on both the ledger and on internal systems.

params.name: transfer_id
params.description: Transfer ID for the label being added.

params.name: label
params.description: Text of the label you want to add to the payment.

items.docs: Adds a list of labels to the transfer. To retrieve transfers by label, see [Get transfers][get-transfers].

params.name: transfer_id
params.description: Transfer ID for the label being removed.

params.name: label
params.description: Labels to be removed.

items.docs: Deletes one or more existing labels from the transfer.
